How do you create an eval?

Pass or fail

PASS
FAIL
The critique carries the nuance
  • Clear enough to act on
  • No false precision from a 1 to 5 scale
  • Lower cognitive load and faster review
  • Agreement and false passes become measurable
  • No "maybe" bucket means a harder alignment problem

An unaligned boolean judge is worse than an unaligned ordinal judge (for example, 1 to 5): every mistake becomes a hard boundary decision.

Question 03

What changes
with agents?

The answer is only the endpoint

Agents require evaluating behavior, rather than final answers.

NR. OF TOKENS →
user turn assistant tool call tool result

Fifty Sphere.com cases. Each bar is one run, each block one message, sized by how much context it added.

EVALS ON THE BEHAVIOR
Tool-call efficiency

Did it query once, or five times for the same fact?

Error recovery

A query fails. Does the run recover, or answer anyway?

Instruction adherence

The user said do not save yet. Did it wait?

Build the eval once.
Then it guards every commit.

DISCOVERY

Build with humans

Hard cases and edge cases. A low pass rate is the eval working; one that never fails is too easy.

REGRESSION

Guard every commit

Known behavior and core paths. Everything passes, or something broke and the commit stops.

Scaling evaluation

Offline, online, continuous

The same criterion runs in all three, and it holds only while production stays inside the slice humans validated.

What a failed eval teaches
the agent and the rubric

Evaluator finding
The analysis reports declining revenue.

It never explains what the CFO should decide.

Agent loop · Sphere skill update
Connect the analysis to the decision.

Explain the commercial drivers, separate evidence from assumptions, lead with the implication.

Evaluator loop · evaluator update
Say what unsupported means.

A claim fails when the visible evidence contradicts it, not merely when proof is absent.

Then rerun decision_support_quality
Evals in the software factory

Automate the preparation.
Keep the decision human.

With software we write tests. With a software factory we build evals.
